# VEPA4 Technical Specification Tree

This directory is generated from the live repository by [scripts/generate-spec.mjs](../../scripts/generate-spec.mjs). It is an evidence-oriented specification, not a second source tree.

Run the procedure with:

`npm run spec:generate`  `npm run spec:check`

The generator extracts runtime constants, law/category metadata, source exports/imports, solver references, UI surfaces, tests, audit files, and operational configuration. It is deterministic: timestamps, host paths, random values, and generated output are excluded from its own input scan.
